intent: Refresh the live First Stage Bill inventory, verify it against current official Oireachtas state, propose the stage-specific grouping and one-slide information hierarchy, then build one representative First Stage Bill slide through the existing Bill Tracker factory for hosted human review. Do not publish or schedule.
references_consulted: Irish Politics Data Model public documentation

decisions.question: Which architecture should the prototype use?
decisions.choice: Extend bill_tracker_factory_v1 on the session branch; no parallel permanent renderer.
decisions.rationale: Current main marks bill_tracker_series as merged and the handoff explicitly requires extending the existing factory.
